title: Creating new versions of Typhoon Thompson Sprites and animations?
author: EasterUK
selftext:
I've been playing with Opus 5.5, trying to create a faithful recreation of the classic game Typhoon Thompson.  So far Claude has written an Amiga emulator, decomiled the game, re-written in Python then Java, extracted all the assets, and re-written the some of the routines - truly jaw dropping.

What I'm struggling with is recreating the graphics, keeping the style and cohesion with the animiations.  See the video for an example of some of the animations.

Has anyone successfully done this already?  Internally it's a 3D game, so it would be possible to transition to 3D and keep the style - but that would mean recreating everything in 3D.  Or even create in 3D and render the sprites out.

Alternatively is there an AI I can feed the animiations in to, which can recreate?

It's very playable, but has a basic AI interface pretty - but if you like you can have a look here:

[Typhoon Thompson](https://typhoon-thompson.pages.dev/web/)
